method: Residents = sum over census tracts of total population (ACS 5-year B01003_001E) x share of the tract's area inside the union of 800 m straight-line buffers around every stop served on the date by the routes of the row (strict tier: routes in the 15-min tier; incl. near-miss routes: those plus routes with a 15-min near miss, a covered direction-period with a median of 901-960 s); area weighting assumes uniform density inside a tract.
